name: offline-coordination
criticalInvariants: Coordination never owns money, balances, capacity or final booking confirmation.
A command identity has one immutable payload within its company and branch.
All owner effects require current platform authorization and an unexpired scoped delegation.
Unknown outcomes retry with the same identity; denied observed cash requests remain reviewable.
An enrolled office authority fences every other server; no heartbeat-driven or automatic authority transfer exists.
